method.type: Manual visible-proportion estimates with independent native eave/width anchors; no metric facade survey or camera calibration.
method.verticalPlacement: Explicit approximate metre datums relative to native ground, selected from visible lower/upper hierarchy and independent shaft offsets. Do not multiply raw photographic y fractions by eave height: the source converges strongly and grade is clipped.
method.confidence: High for counts, unequal zones, ordering and relationship; medium for width fractions and relative opening fill; low-to-medium for metre datums/heights; low for projection/recess/corbel measurements. Rounded candidates are tunable hypotheses, not measured claims.
method.uncertainty: Absolute upper row datums may shift roughly 0.7–1.0m together after comparable native eave render; lower datum uncertainty at least 0.4–0.6m. Preserve source relationships rather than fitting all values independently.
